profiles.name: decision-resident-jsonl-v1
requirements: Exactly one strict JSON object and LF terminator; reject duplicate/unknown keys, wrong scalar type, extra/trailing object/bytes and truncated frame.
New envelopes/chunks must fit existing ceiling; it is source evidence, not implemented new decoder.

profiles.name: decision-record-source-equivalence
profiles.logical_metric: Original question/state/options/abstain_below JSON with json.dumps default ensure_ascii=True and spaced separators, allow_nan=False; original field presence/order preserved.
requirements: Preserve meaningful controls, whitespace and nonBMP Unicode; no normalization, stripping or byte-for-character substitution.
Name must be nonblank per Python strip predicate but equality/uniqueness uses exact original unstripped Unicode string.
Options ordered through hashing, execution and result validation; semantic duplicate keys rejected, not only equal entire records.
Threshold omitted/null/probability and calibration omitted/null/slot are distinct wire variants.
Utf8Chunk intrinsic <=65536 encoded UTF8 bytes from canonical types.toml; chunk count, expanded aggregate and outstanding-profile checks still absent.

Threshold integer0/1 and binary64 float variants preserve original Python int/float type for source-equivalent json.dumps byte accounting; bool refused. Collapsing1 into1.0 changes logical aggregate length and is forbidden.

profiles.name: decision-result-validation
requirements: Exact offered option index set/order, no duplicates/missing scores; finite probabilities0..1, sum tolerance0.0001.
Choice is max probability with offered-order tie resolution. Derive confidence=score[choice], margin=largest minus second-largest score, abstained=(threshold present and confidence<threshold).
Producer decision_from normalizes original raw probs once via Python binary64 arithmetic; never renormalize received already-produced scores as a substitute for validation.
Preserve public latency_ms and batch_ms producer rounding at3 decimal places; FiniteF64 codec adds no rounding/clamping/reformatting.
Worker memory counters are candidates only; working never raises node admitted envelope.

profiles.name: failure-redaction
requirements: Source redacts env secrets before error message; node redacts again before disclosure.
Message Utf8Chunk preserves text but does not supersede source1000-character semantic limit.

Per-direction sequence scoped to exact authenticated private pipe and attempt. Full immutable request digest binds ordered option content, threshold presence, dtype, calibration/config/runtime/load generation, slots and admitted envelope.

Node owns durable principal/resource-generation/request-payload ledger; same request attaches to recorded disposition; changed work refuses and unknown outcome never recomputes.

One candidate/End/cancel winner under node ordering; no post-End result/progress/delivery, duplicate finals do not republish. CancelObserved/End/EOF/exit are observations, never OS cleanup or capacity-release receipts.

Input descriptor transfer bound to exact slot/attempt/direction and actual retained object, reject duplicate/extra handles while retaining cleanup duty. Freeze/snapshot bytes or revoke all writers before validation; read-only FD alone does not prove immutability.

Direct typed decision result candidates only, no output manifest/artifact/chunk/credit/progress or generic JSON fallback. Future output publication must validate and publish same frozen bytes under current authorization.

Worker/log/failure output never grants authority. Logs separate and redacted. FiniteF64/Utf8Chunk are data intrinsics, not proof tokens.

End.last_sequence denotes its own WorkerEventFrame.sequence. Startup/load/encode failure candidates can precede Accepted; successful result requires inputs verified and Accepted. Exact trigger and terminal/cancel state enforcement remain absent, as recorded blockers.
